{{Quote|Tis better to have a bursa at yousa side then at yousa throat, mesa says.|Captain Marsune|<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
A '''clan''' of [[Bursa/Legends|bursas]] lived near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spearhead/Legends|Spearhead]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[3000 BBY]]. As [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo's]] [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Grand army]] prepared to attack [[Raid on Spearhead|attack]] on Spearhead, his ally [[Marsune]] encountered the clan and its wounded [[Bursa leader|leader]]. In exchanged for healing the leader the bursas joined Gallo in his attack.
